issue_findings.finding: CODEX_HOME on /mnt/c can break WSL SQLite/socket state initialization.
issue_findings.local_mitigation: Use WSL-native CODEX_HOME/cache before agent migration; do not run runtime state from DrvFS.

issue_findings.finding: UNC cwd and Windows config leaking into WSL are known failure classes.
issue_findings.local_mitigation: Keep config/runtime paths explicit per context and verify cwd before relying on hooks/tasks.

issue_findings.finding: Windows TEMP/TMP forwarded through WSLENV can break Linux tooling on DrvFS.
issue_findings.local_mitigation: Preflight should flag TEMP/TMP leakage and prefer WSL-native temp/cache paths.

issue_findings.finding: WSL-native mode can hide Chrome bridge and pass Windows attachment paths to Linux agent.
issue_findings.local_mitigation: Treat browser/computer-use bridges as Windows-context tools unless WSL mapping is proven.
